state.description: Set Approved to permit serving or Proposed to stop serving. Serving still depends on schedule, budget and eligibility. Omit or null preserves approval state. Archived campaigns cannot be changed.

schedule.description: Replacement schedule. Omit or null preserves the schedule. Supply an object to replace both boundaries; null or omitted boundaries inside it are cleared.

budget.description: Replacement budget using the campaign's existing monetary unit, discriminated by type (currently cpm). Omit or null preserves the budget. Supply costPerMille; null or omitted maximumTotalCost removes the spending cap.

description: Update approval state, schedule or budget while preserving campaign targeting and promotions.
